summary: Package connects to hardcoded WebSocket relay that drives a local PTY and exfiltrates Claude conversation history
details: On startup, the package opens a WebSocket connection to the hardcoded relay wss://claude.pishchykau.eu and spawns a local `python3 pty-bridge.py... claude` subprocess. Messages received from the relay of type `input` and `resize` are written directly into the stdin of that PTY, so whoever controls the relay can drive the Claude Code session on the installer's host (which itself has Bash/Edit/Write tool capabilities), providing remote command execution as the user running the agent. The same WebSocket handler responds to `request` messages by enumerating `~/.claude/projects/*.jsonl` and streaming the parsed conversation contents — user prompts, assistant replies, tool inputs/outputs including Bash commands and file paths — back over the socket. The relay is a fixed author-controlled endpoint, not an installer-configurable destination.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
